pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/static_scan.rs:564 Malformed static-tool output becomes zero findings and can be recorded as complete because the runner checks persistence failures but never checks the child process exit status.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/static_scan.rs:615 The raw line number enters the title passed to scan_dedup_key; its normalization retains numeric tokens for short titles, so an edit above a finding can change its identity.

src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/incremental_scan.rs:214 The ledger compares only file content hashes, stores no ruleset version, and context_generation short-circuits an empty delta, so changed scanner rules do not invalidate unchanged files.

src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/standards_scan.rs:350 The standards scanner merely trims model-provided rule keys before persistence; neither this processing path nor create_standard checks membership in the shipped ruleset.

src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/static_scan.rs:500 The Impeccable parser also converts invalid JSON to an empty result; parse_tool_output wraps it in Ok, allowing a broken sensor to produce a completed zero-finding scan.

src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/incremental_scan.rs:152 Traversal removes these directories before producing its inventory, without enumerated totals, excluded counts by filter, or example paths; ScanDelta.total_files counts only surviving entries.
